from pathlib import Path
import struct
for fn in ['simple-bw-gimp-2.8.10.xcf','simple-bwa-gimp-2.8.10.xcf','simple-rgba-gimp-2.8.10.xcf']:
 data=Path('autotests/read/xcf/'+fn).read_bytes()
 off=418
 offs=[]
 while True:
  v=struct.unpack('>I',data[off:off+4])[0]; off+=4
  if v==0: break
  offs.append(v)
 print('\n',fn,'layers',offs)
 for lo in offs:
  o=lo; w,h,t=struct.unpack('>III',data[o:o+12]); o+=12; l=struct.unpack('>I',data[o:o+4])[0]; o+=4; name=data[o:o+l]; o+=l
  print('layer',lo,w,h,t,name)
  while True:
   typ,size=struct.unpack('>II',data[o:o+8]); o+=8
   if typ in (6,7,8,11,15): print(' prop',typ,size,data[o:o+size].hex())
   if typ==0: break
   o+=size
  hier,mask=struct.unpack('>II',data[o:o+8]); print('hier',hier,'mask',mask)
  width,height,bpp,lev=struct.unpack('>IIII',data[hier:hier+16]); print(' hierarchy',width,height,bpp,lev,'zero after',data[hier+16:hier+20].hex())
  if lev:
   print(' level',struct.unpack('>III',data[lev:lev+12]),'next',struct.unpack('>I',data[lev+12:lev+16])[0])
